entities.name: Great Pyramid of Giza
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: 146m tall, 2.3 million limestone blocks averaging 2.5 tons each. Built for Pharaoh Khufu. Tallest man-made structure for 3,800 years. Aligned to true north within 3/60th of a degree.
